mentions.name: SourceMinder
mentions.description: A token-saving tool for LLM workflows that the author finds useful even without an LLM; a WASM port lets people try it in the browser, and it is GPL licensed.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still plugging away on SourceMinder (https://github.com/ebcode/SourceMinder). I know, I know, everyone and their brother is working on token-saving schemes for LLMs. But I’ve found it to be useful even without the LLM.

mentions.name: SourceMinder
mentions.description: SourceMinder is a code index tool that finds symbols in a codebase and creates a single-table SQLite database for the index. It uses tree-sitter to parse the AST and record symbols with their kind (function, class, argument, etc). It currently works with TypeScript, C, Go, and PHP, with Perl support in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt: SourceMinder: A “code index” tool that finds symbols in a codebase and creates a single table sqlite database for the index. It uses tree-sitter to parse the AST and add the symbols and what they are (function, class, argument, etc) to the db.
